offers_products.reason: Sells reagents (proteins, antibodies, cytokines), analytical instruments and diagnostic kits under brands like R&D Systems and ProteinSimple.

offers_services.reason: Custom manufacturing and testing services exist, but products are far larger part of the business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are researchers, labs, clinicians and biopharma companies, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to academic labs, biopharma firms, clinical labs and assay developers, often via distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Reagents and consumables are reordered repeatedly by research labs; these form most of revenue versus instruments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Research reagents are routine consumables; demand is tied to research funding and is relatively stable.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a small, frequent reagent, kit or antibody order, not a large one-off purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufactured reagents and instruments, not from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customer base is broad, with many academic labs and small biotechs alongside large pharma.

asset_heavy.reason: Specialty life-science manufacturer with moderate facility needs, not a plant-, fleet- or network-heavy business.

notes: Customer mix is broad, so the large-customer answer is a judgement call.
